faqs.q: How do I invite a new team member?
faqs.a: Navigate to the Team page, click Invite Member, enter their email address, select a role, and send the invitation. They will receive an email with a link to join your workspace.

faqs.q: Can I export my analytics data?
faqs.a: Yes. On the Analytics page, click the Export button in the top-right corner. You can download a CSV or PDF snapshot of all data matching your current filter selections.
Scheduled reports are generated automatically at the configured time and saved to your report-exports storage. You can also configure email delivery from the Reports page.

faqs.q: What does the Conversion Rate metric measure?
faqs.a: Conversion Rate is the percentage of sessions that completed a defined goal action — such as signing up, upgrading a plan, or completing a purchase — during the selected period.

faqs.q: How do I change my workspace timezone?
faqs.a: Go to Settings, select the General tab, and update the Timezone field. All chart timestamps and scheduled report delivery times will update immediately.
